g.text: End-to-End System Architecture, Role Isolation, Middleware Pipeline & Data Flow
JWT Token in HTTP-Only Cookie (7 Days)
XSS-proof: JavaScript cannot access or exfiltrate token string
Strict boundary: Customers ⛔ Vendor/Admin APIs (403 Forbidden)
Vendors can only mutate own catalog items.
Super Admin oversees platform KYC & approvals.
Razorpay webhook ensures zero dropped orders.
20/20 Test Suites Passed (162/162 unit & e2e tests)
Zero-error production builds on Next.js & Express.
